items.title: Amazon Connect Customer custom metrics now supports tag-based access control
items.content_snippet: Amazon Connect Customer now supports tag-based access control for custom metrics, so you can govern which users and roles can view, create, or modify each custom metric. As more teams across your organization adopt custom metrics, they end up editing the same shared library. Without controls, one person can change a metric that other teams count on. The usual fix is to give only a handful of people permissions to custom metrics, but that shuts out every other team that wants to start using them.

items.title: Reimagining IT with ChatGPT
items.content_snippet: Go behind the scenes to see how Open AI's IT team uses ChatGPT to deliver business outcomes.

items.title: Meet ChatGPT: Ask Your First Question | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: New to ChatGPT? Start here. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how to type or speak a question, review the answer, and ask a follow-up to make it simpler or more useful. There’s no need to find the perfect words—just start with one question and continue the conversation. ChatGPT can make mistakes or use outdated information. Always double-check important guidance about health, money, deadlines, government forms, or safety with a trusted professional or official source. #ChatGPT #ChatGPTForBegi

items.title: How to Ask ChatGPT Better Questions | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: A few helpful details can make a big difference. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how to tell ChatGPT what you need, who it’s for, and what kind of answer would be most useful. See how a general dinner question becomes a practical meal plan with simple recipes and an organized shopping list—and how easy it is to adjust the answer without starting over. You don’t need to share private information to get a useful response. Leave out details such as your full name, address, and account numbers.

items.title: Use ChatGPT to Organize Everyday Tasks | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: Turn a busy idea into a simple, manageable plan. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how ChatGPT can help organize household tasks, errands, trips, events, and other everyday projects. Watch how a plan for preparing for visiting family becomes a short checklist organized by day. You can use the same approach to request a list, schedule, or step-by-step plan that works for you. Remember to verify important costs, dates, instructions, and anything involving health or safety. #ChatGPT #ChatGPTForB

items.title: How to Spot Scam Messages with ChatGPT | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: Suspicious email or text? ChatGPT can serve as a second set of eyes. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how to identify common warning signs such as urgent language, unfamiliar links, unusual requests, and demands for money. Never click a suspicious link or call a number included in the message. Verify the claim independently through an official app, website, phone number, or someone you trust. ChatGPT can help you notice warning signs, but it cannot guarantee that a message is safe. #ScamAwar

items.title: ChatGPT Privacy: What Not to Share and When to Double-Check | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: Share only what ChatGPT needs to answer your question. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how to protect personal information and recognize when an AI-generated answer needs to be checked. See how to ask about a utility bill without sharing a name, address, phone number, account number, barcode, or other private details. ChatGPT can help you understand information, get organized, and prepare better questions—but it is not a doctor, banker, lawyer, or official source. You remain in charge. #AIP

items.title: Create a Coloring Page with ChatGPT | OpenAI Academy
items.content_snippet: Let’s use ChatGPT to make something fun. In this quick tutorial, you’ll learn how to create an original black-and-white coloring page using a simple description. See how details such as thick outlines, no shading, and plenty of open space can produce a coloring-friendly image—and how a follow-up request can change one part without starting over. For a simple creative project, request original ideas rather than famous characters or copies of someone else’s artwork. #ChatGPTImages #ColoringPage #C

items.title: Assess Usage and Value of ChatGPT Work
items.content_snippet: See how insights in the ChatGPT Admin Console help you understand AI adoption, usage, and spend across your organization. Explore team use cases, review Codex contributions, and identify where to focus training and expand access. Then use the ChatGPT Admin plugin to turn those analytics into a leadership deck and share it in Slack.

items.title: The End of TCP for AI Clusters — John Ousterhout, Stanford
items.content_snippet: Split a job across several nodes, let their GPUs compute, then have them exchange a little metadata before the next round. Legal work arrives as projects, a project gets worked hard for a while and then is never opened again, and when the team sharded document chunks across four thousand partitions the dead projects landed in the same partitions as the live ones.
